exact_cost_boundary_hash_seed_amendment.rationale: The base frozen protocol required a hash_seed for deterministic exact-cost threshold mixtures but did not assign its value. The value 1729 is frozen before any measured exact-cost development result was observed. It is the first already-prespecified development fold seed and is already used as the boundary-hash fixture in the independent-calibration and required-baseline test contracts. The choice is therefore deterministic and not outcome-selected.

files_and_estimands_affected: current_error_prediction model selection and online score
direct_fusion model selection and decision threshold
reason: Post-freeze implementation-completeness audits found that the v2 protocol named current-error classifiers, downstream fusion classifiers, and log-latency cost predictors while requiring selection from prespecified grids, but omitted complete role-specific candidate grids, inner-selection metrics, exact model-input construction, probability-handling rules, and the latency-prediction target transform. These implementation-specification omissions are corrected before any v2 repeated grouped model-family selection, fresh calibration evaluation, or fresh confirmatory evaluation. Permitted legacy-development material had been inspected during implementation and is disclosed explicitly; no v2 repeated grouped model-selection result was available when the amendment choices were frozen.
